links.outcome: ICU length-of-stay prediction error under controlled degradation of five data quality dimensions
links.effect: Prediction error increased consistently with degradation across completeness, coherence, validity, precision and uniqueness; coherence had the strongest impact; robustness varied by model family.
links.quote: Prediction error increases consistently with degradation, with coherence having the strongest impact, in line with clinical intuition.

links.outcome: Regression error when evaluation inputs had missing, incoherent, invalid, imprecise or duplicated data
links.effect: Models trained on clean data showed consistently rising prediction error as input data quality degraded, with coherence degradation most harmful.
links.quote: Prediction error increases consistently with degradation, with coherence having the strongest impact, in line with clinical intuition.

screen.reason: Evaluates model robustness and performance under simulated data quality degradation on MIMIC-IV data, but does not test an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
